How the app handles data (describes the app as built — verify it before you publish):
• Habits, progress, reminders and settings are stored only on your device.
• The app has no accounts, no ads and no analytics, and it does not request internet access.
• Premium purchases are processed entirely by Google Play. The app only receives the purchase status from Google Play.
• Android may back up app data to your Google account if you have device backup turned on.

Tip: set PRIVACY_POLICY_URL in gradle.properties to open your hosted policy instead of this screen. Google Play also requires a public privacy policy URL in the Play Console.

Subscription summary (verify it matches your Play Console configuration):
• Trackly Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription billed through Google Play.
• You can cancel anytime in Google Play > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions.
• Cancelling stops future renewals; Premium stays active until the end of the paid period.

Tip: set TERMS_OF_SERVICE_URL in gradle.properties to open your hosted terms instead of this screen.
